By Wesley Yin-Poole Updated : Oct 29, 2026 9:40am UTC 8 comments Add IGN on Google GTA 6 made a surprise appearance on South Park with just shy of 20 seconds of genuine, exclusive gameplay that showcased dog poop. The latest episode of Trey Parker and Matt Stone’s hit comedy series, titled Guinea Pig On A Stick, shows a dog doing a poo on a beach (this is South Park after all!). The NPC dog walker picks up the poo, and here things get a little messy. We see Jason attack the NPC with the dog poo, which explodes in their face. That's one way to start a fight. The gameplay is shown during a scene in which the main characters visit a cattle ranche, where a woman hypes up GTA 6 by providing a quick look at the game. “The graphics are seriously next level,” the woman says. “You see the worldbuilding? It’s a dog taking a poop. And people can pick up the dog poop. You can throw things at the person with dog poop, and if they choose to fight back, you can pick up the dog poop and actually attack them with the dog poop. That is what’s coming in November.” “Wow!” Stan says. “Holy s**t!” Kyle exclaims. “Dude, that game looks f***ing tits!” Cartman offers. Here’s the FULL GTA 6 gameplay footage exclusively shown in the latest South Park episode in HD. https://t.co/aMBXWtnKE3 — GTA 6 Info (@GTASixInfo) October 29, 2026 The woman is voiced by Tish Hicks (as confirmed in the credits of the episode). Hicks is a voice actor who narrated the GTA 5 gameplay trailer all those years ago, so fans will probably find her voice familiar. As for the gameplay, Rockstar had confirmed the dog poop mechanic already, but it’s fun to see it in action. And it’s great to get a sense of the density of NPCs on the beach in gameplay, too, given this sort of scene has been at the heart of official pre-launch videos and screenshots. South Park is of course no stranger to video games, with its 2006 World of Warcraft episode perhaps the most high-profile example of Parker and Stone taking aim at the culture. But it’s also had plenty to say about Rockstar games, too. Red Dead Redemption 2, for example, was at the heart of episodes Time to Get Cereal and Nobody Got Cereal? , which featured the game heavily. In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023 View 13 Images With GTA 6’s November 19 release date just weeks away, Rockstar’s marketing has ramped up considerably. And we’re learning more and more about how the game works every day. Overnight, we learned how GTA 6 named one of its biggest mechanics after a beloved GTA 4 meme , and how GTA 6's map will open up relatively early and let you explore freely . Not long now!
